}}'''Shendla''' is a [[Sharan]] female [[channeler]], one of leaders of the [[Ayyad]]. [[Demandred]] considered her devious, capable, and powerful.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Shendla}} Demandred felt affection for her, something that surprised him.

== Activities ==
While [[Demandred]] was establishing himself as Bao the Wyld in [[Shara]], Shendla developed a relationship with him. While she is not a [[Darkfriend]], she fought alongside the [[Forsaken]] and [[Shadowspawn]], believing that they could save her people if they won.{{ref/book|14|37}} She also truly loved Demandred.

<nowiki> </nowiki>After Demandred is killed by [[Lan Mandragoran]], Shendla announces his death to her people.{{ref/book|14|38}}
